title: Whispers of Grace | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled within a serene setting with sweeping views of Western Lake, this opulent retreat is the epitome of luxury and comfort, perfect for large gatherings or family vacations. With its elegant dual king master suites, each boasting lush seating areas, private porches, and spacious limestone, marble, glass, and pebble-tiled bathrooms, the residence offers an unparalleled living experience. Additional sleeping quarters include two expansive king bedrooms, a cozy twin bunk room accommodating four, and a queen pullout sofa, comfortably housing up to 14 guests. The property is further enhanced by two full kitchens, making it a culinary enthusiast’s dream. The gourmet main kitchen is equipped with high-end Subzero and Wolf appliances, including two dishwashers and a wine refrigerator, while the third-floor media room includes a full kitchen setup with modern amenities. Outdoor living is redefined in this exquisite home, where a private saltwater swimming pool, a gas fire pit, and a sunlit cupola on the fourth floor invite guests to relax and enjoy the natural beauty of the surroundings. The large sun deck and four charming porches provide ample space for enjoying the outdoors, whether it's dining under the stars or lounging by the pool. The property’s luxurious interiors are matched by its stunning outdoor areas, complete with a gas BBQ grill and scenic views that capture the essence of a WaterColor vacation. From the wire-brushed hardwood floors to the 12-foot ceilings and sophisticated decor, every detail has been meticulously crafted to ensure a memorable and lavish stay for guests seeking both relaxation and style.
